'''Weogar''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]]. The [[Purghom Musical Performance Hall]] was a public auditorium in the city. Weogar once experienced violent riots after a performance by the [[Smazzo/Legends|smazzo]] group [[Shluur]] provoked aggressive tendencies in the Bith population, requiring the group to be escorted offplanet.
